props.name: label
props.description: Accessible, visible label (required).

props.name: items
props.description: Ordered list of all options.

props.name: values
props.description: The selected values (controlled). Replace the array; do not mutate it.

props.name: onValuesChange
props.description: Called with the next values after a user action.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Input placeholder. Defaults to the i18n catalog's "Search…".

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Review-only: focus works, opening/adding/removing do not.

props.name: max
props.description: Cap on additions; never removes existing values.

props.name: removeOnBackspace
props.description: Opt in to Backspace removal from an empty input.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; one hidden input per value is submitted under it.

props.name: required
props.description: Expose `aria-required` on the input. Native constraint validation cannot cover hidden multi-value inputs; validation stays with the application.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Empty-result row text. Defaults to the i18n catalog's "No results".
